title: Really good for young kids
text:
Got this for my 5 year old who couldn't read and at first I was disappointed that it was text based instead of image based like most kid coding stuff, but my daughter was so excited that she pushed through it anyway and got a lot better at reading as a result. She gets really excited whenever a new kit arrives.

Note: I'm a software engineer and kids love imitating their parents, so other kids might not be as excited, but it's a good product.
label: positive
